scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.prebuild: cd apps/api && node prisma/set-provider.js && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:admin && npm run build:merchant && npm run build:portal && npm run build:launcher && npm run build:copy && npm run build:deps
scripts.build:copy: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');function copyDir(src,dest){if(!fs.existsSync(dest))fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(src,{withFileTypes:true})){const s=p.join(src,e.name),d=p.join(dest,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())copyDir(s,d);else fs.copyFileSync(s,d)}}copyDir('apps/api/dist','dist');fs.copyFileSync('dist-package.json','dist/package.json');console.log('Copied apps/api/dist + package.json to dist/')"
scripts.build:deps: cd dist && npm install --production --ignore-scripts && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');function cp(s,d){if(!fs.existsSync(s))return;if(fs.statSync(s).isDirectory()){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s))cp(p.join(s,e),p.join(d,e))}else{fs.mkdirSync(p.dirname(d),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(s,d)}}cp('../node_modules/.prisma','node_modules/.prisma');cp('../apps/api/node_modules/.prisma','node_modules/.prisma');console.log('Prisma client copied')"
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:studio: cd apps/api && npm run prisma:set-provider && npx prisma studio
